LanguageData.Homesteader_LittleGuyLetterText:
Homesteader has added a new trait: Little guy.

It does nothing.

Pawns may roll it naturally; you can also add it in character creation / editor.
LanguageData.Homesteader_NeedsSoapInWashTub: Needs soap in the wash tub.
LanguageData.Homesteader_PassiveCoolStorage: Passive cool storage: items (and adjacent indoor cells) stay at or below {0}
LanguageData.Homesteader_SettingsUseRefreshedTextures: Swap Homesteader buildings, items, plants, and floors to the optional unique art pack. Original sprites stay in the mod; this is off by default. Each def has its own texture (no shared jam/cellar/etc. placeholders).
Restart RimWorld after changing this if any sprites look stale.
LanguageData.Homesteader_SettingsRevealAllergiesTip: Tastes tab shows allergy names before discovery (eating the food or environmental exposure). For testing only.
LanguageData.Homesteader_SettingsDevModeHint: Enable Development mode to show Homesteader developer options.
LanguageData.Homesteader_KatsLetter_Open: An anomalous broadcast has locked onto your colony's 27 monument frequency. A brief heat dome is forming over the region, and several colonists report a short-lived fogginess — "brain rot," they call it.
LanguageData.Homesteader_KatsLetter_SilverTaken: Colony accounts show {0} silver diverted as a "Super Chat." Containment breach averted.
LanguageData.Homesteader_KatsLetter_KatsSpawned: The broadcast demanded {0} silver as a "Super Chat." The colony couldn't pay — and SCP-27272727 manifested as a hostile {1} named Kats at the map edge.
LanguageData.Homesteader_KatsLetter_NoSilver: The broadcast demanded {0} silver as a "Super Chat," but the colony had no silver to spare (and Kats failed to materialize).
LanguageData.Homesteader_KatsLetter_ContainmentNote: Containment note: hydrate / medicate / masticate. Do not look away from the number.
